items.title: A finitely presented map of affine schemes descends to a finite type map over a Z-scheme of finite type
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a morphism f : X -> S of affine schemes of finite presentation, the lemma produces a cartesian diagram with X_0 -> S_0 affine, S_0 of finite type over Z, and f_0 of finite type, through which X -> S factors. The retained proof writes the translation into algebra: S = Spec A, X = Spec B, finite presentation of f means B is of finite presentation as an A-algebra (via Morphisms, lemma-locally-finite-presentation-characterize), and the claim is then Algebra, lemma-limit-module-finite-presentation. Retained author proof at lines 9756-9764.
